finding: The exact TameQuotientData asserts the actual dyadic tame quotient as data; LiteratureInputs.tameQuotient supplies it as a literature hypothesis. Tame.lean proves iterated conjugation, odd order, cyclic-subgroup normality and normal 2-subgroup centrality in finite groups already satisfying the dyadic tame relation. These do not construct the actual tame quotient for arbitrary selected auxiliary primes.
decision: No import. The exact actual-local-field identification is still required. Native prime-local residue inertia, finite unramified restriction and first-order deformation criteria give the shorter proved route for the present baseline unramified condition.
boundary: Bounded source review, not an exhaustive absence claim. General tame local-ring geometry, Delta_Q action and arithmetic patching realization remain open.
